notes: Corrected car-course route uses the direct eastern return beside the covered paddock, excluding the old karting diagonal/upper-arc detour. Exact current OSM source nodes and joins are retained. The operator plan and pinned imagery support branch identity only; no diagram or imagery coordinates are copied. Independent source distance 1886.6 m is not fitted to an operator or catalogue scalar. Historical configuration and driving direction remain draft.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.
Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union, EU-DEM layers.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 66 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Estimated limits from98 independent native-image edge readings at54 source cross-sections, plus2 repeated closure controls. Native-image asphalt/grass and visible white road-edge/curb controls, independently read on the corrected source trace. Requested grid0.3972m, sensor-native detail and capture date unknown; roughly1m reading uncertainty, not surveyed accuracy. Offsets interpolate on original source normals, except southeastern shared-paving opening0..20 where edge coordinates interpolate linearly between visible controls. Inner10,220,240 and outer180/200 have no invented observations. Outer595..626 interpolates93m across roof-obscured limits beside the covered paddock and pedestrian walkway; no roof edge is labelled an observed road edge. Inner610 at the walkway is also unobserved and interpolated. Shared-paving openings, painted limits and all intervals between controls are estimates, not verified event barriers. Original trace/timing remain unchanged, configuration/direction draft, terrain approximate, curbs illustrative and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
